Table Tent Printing: Compact and Attention-Grabbing Promotional Tools


Table tents are the perfect printed promotional tools for displaying bestsellers, discounts, and offers. Place them in reception desks, cashier counters, and restaurant tables for maximum exposure. From restaurants and cafes to hotels, retail stores, and service providers, custom table tents have always been a popular marketing tool. With eye-catching graphics paired with legible fonts, they are perfect to highlight bestsellers, introduce new products, list services or products with prices, announce promotions, and advertise contests or events.

The Perfect Setup for Your Custom Table Tents

Not sure where to start? Here’s the most recommended pairing for a table tent that looks great, stands strong, and gets noticed.


4.25" x 6" – Just the Right Size


Our most popular size hits the sweet spot. It’s large enough to catch attention, yet compact enough to fit seamlessly on any table. Perfect for menus, promotions, or featured messages.

14 pt. Cardstock – Built to Impress


Strong, sleek, and professional—this premium cardstock is our top choice. Choose from Gloss, Matte, or High Gloss (UV) finishes to make your design pop and stand tall with confidence.

Where Table Tents Work Best

From everyday promotions to special celebrations, table tents are a smart, stylish way to share your message and make a lasting impression.



Promote Your Business

Use table tents to highlight products, special offers, or services. Place them on counters, tables, or reception areas to grab attention and drive sales. They also make great branded giveaways—add a calendar and keep your business top of mind all year.

Perfect for Events

Table tents bring both style and purpose to any event. Use them as centerpieces, menus, or programs for weddings, parties, and corporate gatherings. They keep guests informed while enhancing your event’s look and feel.

Inform and Guide Customers

Table tents are great for sharing helpful information, such as safety guidelines, store hours, contact details, or check-in instructions. Ideal for hotels, clinics, and offices, they ensure customers see what they need to know—right when they need it.

Table Tent Printing FAQs

Q: Do table tents come pre-assembled or will I need to set them up?

Your table tents will arrive flat and unfolded to protect them during shipping. Each one has two interlocking flaps at the bottom. Just fold along the scored lines and tuck the flaps together for a quick and easy setup. No tools or glue are needed.

Q: How long is the printing turnaround time for custom table tents?

Your table tents are ready to be shipped in 4-6 business days.

Q: Do you have free design templates for table tents?

Yes. Our customizable templates provide a structure and visual style to meet your specific needs and help you save time and effort in the design process.

Q: Do you offer free digital proofs?

Yes. We offer digital proofs for our printing services. You can request a free PDF proof by checking the “Please send me a PDF proof for approval before printing.” You need to review and approve your design so we can proceed with production.

Q: What are the recommended file formats?

PDF, JPG, JPEG, PSD, PNG, TIF, TIFF, EPS, Illustrator, Publisher, DOCX, DOC, XLS, XLSX. PPT, PPTX, TXT, CSV, BMP, GIF, SVG, ZIP 

Q: Can I add a QR code to my custom table tents?

Of course! This way, you can direct customers to your website, online store, or landing page. Just make sure that your QR code is of high quality (i.e., high contrast, aligned properly, and at least 2 x 2 cm) to avoid scanning issues later on.

Q: What cardstock options are available for table tents, and how do they differ?

Here are the seven cardstock options for your tabletop signage: 

Cardstock Options 

Key Features 

10 pt. Cardstock Gloss 

The lightest cardstock option with a glossy, scratch-resistant coating.  

14 pt. Cardstock Gloss 

It is more substantial than 10 pt. but has the same key features. 

14 pt. Cardstock Matte 

 

It has a non-reflective finish that suits classic and minimalist designs.   

14 pt. Cardstock High Gloss (UV) 

This option has a UV gloss coating, creating a mirror-like finish that's resistant to scratches and fading. 

14 pt. Cardstock High Gloss (UV) Front, Uncoated Back  

The uncoated side has a writable surface, while the UV finish side has a reflective, scratch-resistant finish. 

16 pt. Cardstock Gloss 

The extra thickness gives the table tent a more durable, luxurious feel, while the reflective finish lets the colors pop. 

16 pt. Cardstock Matte 

The extra thickness gives the table tent a more durable, luxurious feel, while the matte finish is ideal for classic and minimalist designs.
